independent_ablation_comparison.bounded_conclusion: Removing two template-triggering calls eliminated six Tabular3D/4D diffusion kernel specializations and reduced observed device-generation/assembly phase durations in this diagnostic sample. This supports contribution of the instantiated EOS test matrix to this TU cost; it does not isolate interpolation cost or prove any accepted optimization.
limits: Ablation deliberately removes Tabular failure/recovery test coverage, cannot be used as a scientific PASS or production optimization, and must not replace the original test.
One original and one ablated compile on this machine cannot establish general full-build benefit, variance, or runtime improvement.
NVCC phase sums and external guarded wall time remain distinct measurement units; no percentage is a decomposition of wall time.
Compiler flags are preserved; changing source location can change generated anonymous-namespace symbol spelling, so family preservation is checked semantically.
